title: Office of Personnel Management Structural Change Audit — 2025–2026
bluf: Existing OPM legal and personnel-control evidence was substantial but scattered. The fixed-window audit preserves those owners and recovers underdeveloped operating chains in digital retirement, Federal HR 2.0 and shared services, personnel records and workforce data, AI hiring, appraisal and ranking, PSHB, retirement-payment integrity and the judicial boundary on OPM-directed probationary separations.
